environment_notes: Snow whipping violently at the base
style_notes: Harsh lighting reflecting off the ice

semantic_context.visual_goal: Establish the terrifying scale of the obstacle and the fatigue of the men.
semantic_context.action_focus: The towering ice wall dwarfing the soldiers.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Pan up from the frozen men to the impossibly high, vertical cliff.
video_motion_hints: The camera slowly pans upward along the towering ice wall. Swirling snow whips aggressively across the stationary figures below.

semantic_context.action_focus: Wei shivering and gesturing wildly at the cliff.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Over the shoulder of Zhao, focusing on Wei's desperate expression.
video_motion_hints: Wei shivers continuously, making frantic, jerky hand gestures. The blowing snow rushes dynamically across the frame between the two men.
semantic_context.dialogue_text: General, without gear, the men will freeze before we reach the summit. It is suicide!

semantic_context.action_focus: Zhao's steely gaze cutting through the blowing snow.
video_motion_hints: Zhao's expression remains completely motionless and intense. Windblown snow whips past his face, with a slight twitch of his jaw.
semantic_context.dialogue_text: If we don't climb, our brothers in the valley die.

semantic_context.action_focus: The heavy armor hitting the snow, followed by bare hands gripping ice.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Follow the armor as it drops, then tilt up to Zhao grabbing the rock.
video_motion_hints: The heavy armor impacts the snow with a heavy thud, sending up a small spray of white powder. The camera smoothly tilts up to follow Zhao's hands finding a firm grip on the ice.

style_notes: High contrast moonlight against dark rock
Kinetic, unstable atmosphere due to wind

semantic_context.visual_goal: Establish the lethal stakes of the nighttime climb.
semantic_context.action_focus: The straining line of men clinging to the mountain.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Looking down from above to show the terrifying drop below.
video_motion_hints: Snow blows violently across the dark chasm. The thick hemp rope sways slightly under the immense tension of the climbing silhouettes.

semantic_context.action_focus: The rope snapping and Wei losing his grip.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Tilt down rapidly following Wei's sudden drop.
video_motion_hints: The rope fibers rapidly unravel and visibly snap apart. The camera aggressively tilts downward following Wei's sudden, terrifying freefall into the dark.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Show the raw, physical sacrifice Zhao makes for his men.
semantic_context.action_focus: Zhao's bleeding hands holding the immense weight.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Tight on Zhao's agonizingly strained hands gripping the frayed rope.
video_motion_hints: Zhao's bare hands tremble violently under the immense pulling weight. Bright, dark droplets of blood fall slowly onto the pale ice below.

semantic_context.action_focus: Zhao yelling over the deafening wind, muscles trembling.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Looking down Zhao's arm toward Wei dangling in the dark.
video_motion_hints: Zhao's arm shakes with extreme physical exertion as he yells down into the void. Wei sways perilously in the howling wind.
semantic_context.dialogue_text: Hold onto the line! I have you!

environment_notes: Massive enemy encampment with large canvas tents
Mountain fog rolling into the rear of the camp
style_notes: Fiery, warm lighting contrasting with the cold mountain fog

semantic_context.visual_goal: Build immense tension before the strike.
semantic_context.action_focus: The silent advance of the vanguard troops out of the mist.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Slow lateral track following the terrifying, silent approach of the men.
video_motion_hints: The camera slowly tracks laterally as the grim soldier glides silently forward. Thick fog rolls lazily over the dark, uneven ground.

semantic_context.action_focus: Zhao screaming the order, shattering the silence.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Tight on Zhao as he raises his blade, eyes burning with fury.
video_motion_hints: Zhao fiercely thrusts his blade upward into the frame while his mouth opens in a deafening shout. Frost crumbles from his shoulders with the sudden, violent movement.
semantic_context.dialogue_text: Burn it all to the ground!

semantic_context.visual_goal: Show the overwhelming shock and fire of the ambush.
semantic_context.action_focus: Torches flying through the night sky and igniting tents.
semantic_context.framing_notes: Pan following the glowing arcs of the thrown torches.
video_motion_hints: Blazing torches fly rapidly in glowing arcs across the dark sky. The camera pans smoothly to follow their trajectory as the flames burst upon impacting the tents.

semantic_context.visual_goal: Convey the complete destruction of the enemy forces.
semantic_context.action_focus: The burning tents and scattering, defeated enemy.
semantic_context.framing_notes: An epic, sweeping view of the burning camp in total disarray.
video_motion_hints: Heavy canvas tents rapidly collapse inward as roaring flames consume them. Soldiers scatter in blind panic while Zhao relentlessly presses the assault forward.
